spans.s:
m. (-रुः)
1 The beard of corn.
2 An arrow.
3 A heron.
E.
किं what, or sometimes, शृ to injure, &c. रुण् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A tree bearing beautiful red blossoms, and hence often alluded to by the poets, (Butea frondosa); also पलाश. []
E.
किं what, something, शुक a parrot; its red flowers being of the colour of a parrot's beak.

m. (-कः)
A species of the Kiṃśuka: see the preceding.

m. (-नुः)
An insect described as having eight legs and a very slender body, a species of spider.
E.
किं for किञ्चित् a little, and तनु the body.

ind.
Whether, either of any.
E.
किं, and तरप् with आमु added.

ind.
Whether, either of two.
E.
किं, and तरप् with आमु added.

Moreover, further.
E.
A compound particle of किं and तु disjunctive particle.

m. (-घ्नः)
One of the eleven periods called Karaṇas.

m. (-रः)
1 A demigod attached to the service of KUVERA, a celestial quirister or musician.
2 A kind of follower or attendant on a Jina or Jaina saint.
f. (-री)
A female Kinnara, or chorister.
E.
किं what, used contemptuously, (what kind of) नर a man: the Kinnara having, with the human figure, the head of a horse.

m. (-शः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
किन्नर a Kinnara, and ईश master, lord; also other similar compounds, as किन्नरेश्वर.

ind.
1 A particle of interrogation, (what?)
2 Doubt, (how, what?)
3 Comparison, (thus, as, like, how much less.)
4 Conjunction, (again, further.)
5 Place, location, and
6 Agency.
E.
किम्, and नु conjoined.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
1 A labourer or cultivator of the soil.
2 Small, little.
3 Covetous, niggardly.
4 A slayer of cattle.
m. (-शः)
1 A name of

A particular monkey.
E.
की for का or कु bad, vile, नाश who destroys, the causal form of नश to destroy, with अच् aff.
